$description: Typography tokens. The font family was confirmed by the project owner (Geist, 2026-09-30) and is self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/geist. Sizes were inferred from glyph heights measured on the 2x screenshots (CSS px = image px / 2) and are still estimated.

xs.seen: stat labels/captions, meta row, author line, email, bar labels, role, footer note

base.seen: nav items, body text, inputs, buttons, column titles, card titles, subtitles

md.seen: panel titles, workspace name, client names
